adjudications: Original broad menu assertion rejected native Tab focus to browser chrome. Corrected trace requires modal state, rejects background DOM focus and proves BODY occurs only with document.hasFocus=false. All seven menu/anchor cases rerun.
A fixed 1100ms wait observed landscape Contacts before native smooth scrolling finished. Settled-scroll polling passes all seven sizes; no product anchor patch.
Initial catalogue-empty screenshots showed the previous viewport because selectOption does not scroll the page. All catalogue states reshot with the actual result in view.

Final 320px catalogue padding and success-scroll reset were found by screenshot review after the broad matrix. Final source check/build, existing e2e, six width/engine checks, fourteen Chromium affected state groups, two WebKit affected groups and all six selected screenshots were rerun. Unaffected gallery/reading/native-close/route cases retain their explicitly named prior reports.
Resize geometry assertions wait two animation frames; immediate computed style can expose the old value during the existing .01ms reduced-motion CSS transition.
forms: All current enquiry requests mocked or blocked; no real submission, Blob receipt, CRM or email test. Historical storage evidence belongs to prior releases.
limitations: No promise of exact pixel equality for every animated frame
Source photography resolution and supplied inventory remain bounded by provided assets
Production deployment and live acceptance are owned by root release report
